parsed.rationale: Both methods reside in `Shared/Wallpaper/Tests/WallpaperTests/QualitySignalTests.swift` and belong to the type `QualitySignalTests`, which is unambiguously a test class despite the pipeline reporting `is_test: false` on both records — the file path and type name are dispositive. The two methods, `hysteresisHeatingEntry` and `hysteresisHeatingExit`, represent the symmetric entry and exit sides of a hysteresis heating scenario; their structural similarity is intentional and their semantic distinction (opposing state transitions) is load-bearing for test clarity. Merging or extracting them would obscure which condition each test case exercises and couple two deliberately independent test scenarios.
